title: On Pulling the rope hand over hand
subtitle: 工程建造 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）
meta: 主题语境：工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）　|　核心词汇：pull　|　正文 347 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 pull 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1949 the painter ① pulled the rope hand over hand in public, and every visitor in the studio said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the painter ② pulls the rope hand over hand in silence without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ pull the rope hand over hand at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ pulled the rope hand over hand before — a line in the catalogue for May 1943 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Pulling the rope hand over hand in public, the painter said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the brush at the far easel, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ pull the old fence out by the roots in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Pull the old fence out by the roots at once and never mention it again.

By 1956 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the catalogue, and a new visitor from the next studio ⑧ pulls the old fence out by the roots in public every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the easel, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ pulled the rope hand over hand again when nobody else would.

⑩ To pull the rope hand over hand, my mother said in 1961, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the studio remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the studio forgets, somebody pulls the rope hand over hand in silence again and somebody must pull the rope hand over hand in public all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 拉（一般过去式 pulled the rope hand over hand：1949 年画师头一回这样做，当着众人面）
B. v. 拉（一般现在 pulls the rope hand over hand：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 拉（不定式 to pull the rope hand over hand：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 拉（过去完成时 had pulled the rope hand over hand：1943 年五月的展品目录上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 拉（动名词 pulling the rope hand over hand 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 拔起（pull the old fence out by the roots：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去拔起把那道旧篱连根拔起）
G. v. 拔起（pull the old fence out by the roots：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 拉（后段两处：新来的观者照例 pulls the old fence out by the roots，而母亲又一次 pulled the rope hand over hand）

answers.why: pull 意为“拉”，1949 年画师当着众人面拉两手倒着拉那根绳子，那是画室里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 pulled。
pull 意为“拉”，自那以后画师一言不发地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 pulls。
pull 意为“拉”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯拉两手倒着拉那根绳子”，此处为不定式 to pull the rope hand over hand。
pull 意为“拉”，展品目录里 五月 那行字说明早在 1956 年之前就有人拉过，故用过去完成时 had pulled。
pull 意为“拉”，画师说“拉两手倒着拉那根绳子这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 pulling the rope hand over hand 作主语。
pull 意为“拔起”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去拔起把那道旧篱连根拔起”，should ever 之后用原形 pull the old fence out by the roots。
pull 意为“拔起”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻拔起把那道旧篱连根拔起（pull the old fence out by the roots at once），以后再也不要提起。
pull 意为“拉”，新来的观者每个季度都照例拔起把那道旧篱连根拔起，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 pulls。
pull 意为“拉”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当着众人面拉两手倒着拉那根绳子，用一般过去式 pulled 叙述。
pull 意为“拉”，结尾那句是母亲 1961 年的话：要拉两手倒着拉那根绳子，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和画室记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 pull 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1949 the painter pulled the rope hand over hand in public, and nobody in the studio forgot it.
Even now the painter pulls the rope hand over hand in silence whenever the studio asks.
Pulling the rope hand over hand in public, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever pull the old fence out by the roots in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new visitor from the next studio pulls the old fence out by the roots in public every season, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother pulled the rope hand over hand again, and the studio remembered that half.
